cross_period_synthesis.dominant_macro_sequence: Oil/Hormuz shock -> persistent inflation risk -> high long-end yields / uncertain Fed path -> constrained broad risk transmission.
cross_period_synthesis.dominant_crypto_sequence: Repeated BTC-specific institutional/ETF/corporate demand headlines -> price resilience or absorption -> exchange-flow/distribution warnings -> limited evidence of broad ecosystem expansion.
structural_items: Institutional Bitcoin ETF and custody infrastructure deepened materially across the period.
Bitcoin security/custody events (Coldcard and protocol-fork episodes) were recurrent but usually secondary to macro/order-flow conditions for price direction.
Regulatory and sanctions developments increasingly intersected with Bitcoin payment rails and institutional products.
cross_period_synthesis.framework_read: The period reinforces the existing ETF-era distinction between BTC resilience and ecosystem health. It supports using geopolitical/rates conditions as catalyst context while requiring actual ETH/BTC, breadth, deployment and survival confirmation for rotation.
